report.answer: Fixed: stock was being taken from the most recently received batch first; it now follows the FEFO rule in docs/DATA.md (earliest expiry first, no expiry last, then received first, then lower id), so bechamel takes milk lot HD-1022 before HD-1026. Added two regression tests in tests/stock.test.js (the milk case and the tie-break order) and a CHANGELOG entry; `npm test` (28 pass) and `npm run lint` pass.
